* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 17 release; card image first published 21 December 2021<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Dark/large/closetheblastdoors.gif</code> as published 21 December 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8190af827ca5ef713205ed8648e28428656b00b1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Dark/large/closetheblastdoors.gif holotable commit 8190af8] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Deploy on table. Rebel Barrier is a Lost Interrupt. If opponent just canceled a battle (or just moved a character, starship, or vehicle away from a battle), opponent loses 1 Force. If Landing Claw just lost, place it out of play.” The PC published pixel-identical copies of this image on 5 July 2022 (file format change only; no visible change). Sheet label “•Close The Blast Doors!” (Virtual Set 17 sheet, Updated December 2022).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Blast Door Controls (V)]]): Card image published 30 December 2024, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set17Type.html Virtual Set 17 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Dark/large/closetheblastdoors.gif</code> as published 30 December 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Dark/large/closetheblastdoors.gif holotable commit 9d2c01e] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Deploy on table. Cancels Blast The Door, Kid!, Narrow Escape, and Rebel Barrier. If opponent just canceled a battle (or just moved a character, starship, or vehicle away from a battle), opponent loses 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' Game text: “Cancels Blast The Door, Kid!, Narrow Escape, and” was added; “Barrier is a Lost Interrupt.” became “Barrier.”; “If Landing Claw just lost, place it out of play.” was removed. The title changed from “•Close The Blast Doors!” to “•Blast Door Controls” and the margin note from “Full Scale Alert” to “Blast Door Controls” (a title change is a version: Bill, 9 November 2026).
